verdict.rationale: Meltano's CLI-first architecture allows running many pipelines (extractors/loaders) 'in one place, across databases, files, SaaS tools' and lets you select many streams/properties at once for extraction, which supports a form of bulk operation across items, and `meltano add`/`config` commands are idempotent for batch plugin management. However there's no explicit documentation or evidence of AI-native bulk operation tooling (e.g., batch APIs, bulk editing across many records) — missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation API/CLI batch commands, evidence of scale/performance across many items, and any AI-specific bulk-processing feature.
